Sam (Finance): Heads-up — QuantumHealth submitted a ticket: they're seeing a burst/overage line on top of their reserved commit for 2026-04-02 18:10-18:25 UTC. Can billing confirm duplication?
Noah (Billing): Pulling INV-2026-0768. There's a reserved commit and a burst charge referencing nodepool qh-prod-7 overlapping the same minutes.
Leah (CS): Customer success noted a short cross-region failover at ~18:12 UTC due to maintenance. We expected traffic to be served by reserved capacity after failover.
Ravi (Ops): Grabbing metering export and router traces now. If the metering exporter emitted the same meter_id to both buckets because of a race, that'd produce duplicate billing.
billing-bot: Auto-scan: INV-2026-0768 shows identical meter_ids in reserved_bucket and burst_bucket. Recommend manual audit.
Sam (Finance): Please attach metering CSV for qh-prod-7 18:00-18:30 UTC. Need an estimated overcharge ASAP.
Ravi (Ops): Exported — short excerpt: ```
2026-04-02T18:12:05Z qh-prod-7 reserved_bucket tokens=15,480 meter_id=mi-7f2a
2026-04-02T18:12:05Z qh-prod-7 burst_bucket tokens=15,480 meter_id=mi-7f2a
```
Leah (CS): That's definitely a double-count. Customer already escalated to their finance lead. We should offer provisional relief.
Nora (AcctMgr): Agreed. What's the estimated value? Sam?
Sam (Finance): Duplicate tokens ~15,480 — roughly $123. To avoid friction propose provisional credit $150 (covers rounding/tax) and offer a 2% SLA credit on next monthly committed invoice as goodwill.
Noah (Billing): I can create a provisional credit memo but need Nora's approval to apply. Will tag as provisional_credit and hold final adjustment until Ops finishes the audit and vendor coordination.
Nora (AcctMgr): Approved for provisional credit $150 and the 2% SLA credit offer. I'll review the customer message before sending.
Ravi (Ops): Root cause: metering exporter race when router retried assignment during failover; dedupe key didn't include request_retry_index. Fix merged and deployed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/2644 deployed 2026-04-04 10:12 UTC. Full audit uploaded: s3://redwood-billing-audits/2026-04/quantumhealth-dup-2445678901.csv
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-3738 - "QuantumHealth duplicate metering - provisional credit issued" assigned to Noah.
Sam (Finance): Noah, please include billing_note=duplicate_meter_race in the memo. Also mark the invoice as "under_review" in the billing system.
Noah (Billing): Credit memo CM-2026-PROV-418 created and applied to INV-2026-0768 on 2026-04-10. billing_note=duplicate_meter_race. Provisional amount $150 applied.
Leah (CS): I'll draft a customer-friendly note explaining non-technical cause and the remediation steps. Nora — can you OK the wording?
Nora (AcctMgr): Yes. Suggested customer copy: "We've applied a provisional credit of $150 to your invoice and are completing a detailed reconciliation. We're also offering a 2% SLA credit on your next committed invoice as a goodwill gesture. We'll follow up within 7 business days with final numbers."
Sam (Finance): Good. One more action — can Ops confirm whether the cloud provider observed retried attach events? If so we may coordinate a joint postmortem.
Ravi (Ops): Reached out to cloud-metering@azure.com; they saw duplicate attach traces for the instance due to a guest-attach retry and are investigating.
Noah (Billing): Updating BILL-3738 with all notes and will hold final adj pending the full audit.
billing-bot: Reminder added to BILL-3738 for 7-day followup.
Sam (Finance): Thanks everyone. Marking this thread resolved when final reconciliation posted.
Noah (Billing): Noted — provisional credit applied, will update ticket after Ops confirms final reconciliation.
Sam (Finance): Closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
